## Submission Metadata

Please fill out every field below. These values are used for benchmark review and leaderboard display.

```yaml
method_name: REPLACE_WITH_METHOD_NAME
authors: REPLACE_WITH_AUTHOR_LIST
affiliation: REPLACE_WITH_AFFILIATION
paper_url: REPLACE_WITH_PAPER_URL_OR_NA
code_url: REPLACE_WITH_CODE_URL_OR_NA
contact_email: REPLACE_WITH_CONTACT_EMAIL
benchmark: REPLACE_WITH_BENCHMARK_NAME
short_description: REPLACE_WITH_ONE_OR_TWO_SENTENCES
```

## Checklist

- [ ] I added exactly one submission CSV under `submissions/<benchmark>/`
- [ ] The CSV follows the required ACCIDENT submission format
- [ ] The metadata block above is complete and accurate
